pred_ddx.label: Invasive mammary carcinoma with neuroendocrine features

Invasive ductal carcinoma: The patient's biopsy revealed an invasive adenocarcinoma of the breast, characterized by average-sized cells with well-defined borders and polygonal contours, forming a matrix of solid, lobular, acinar, and papillary areas.
Invasive mammary carcinoma with neuroend: The tumor showed a degree of neuroendocrine activity, as indicated by positive staining for Chromogranin and Synaptophysin, in addition to the invasive adenocarcinoma characteristics.
